title: AI Recruiter | Proctored, Authentic, Agentic Hiring at Scale
text:
Meet the most authentic AI recruiter
Hiring today is unpredictable.
Resumes are AI-generated, candidates use deepfakes and stand-ins, and the best talent quietly slips through while teams spend weeks talking to the wrong people. Our AI Recruiter changes that.
Built on twenty-five years of hiring data and recruiter expertise, it runs every step of the hiring funnel with the precision of a seasoned recruiter and the scale of automation, delivering recommendations that are accurate, explainable, and trustworthy.

Choose a versatile AI recruiter that adapts to you
Versatile across roles. Versatile across the funnel.
Our AI Recruiter is built to handle the full spectrum of hiring, not just a narrow slice of it. It works across every level and skill set: from interns to managers, non-technical to deep coding, and generalist to highly specialized roles.
It also works across every step of your funnel. Job authoring, JD-to-resume matching, candidate shortlisting, screening, interviewing, and reporting; all run by AI agents working in coordination, end-to-end.
Recruiters stay in control of every decision; the system takes care of everything in between.
From a prompt or JD to ready-to-run
Setup starts with two simple inputs: a job description or a written prompt. Upload one or send it via API, and the AI agent analyzes it like an experienced recruiter, identifying the skills, experience, concepts, and difficulty levels required for the role.
From there, it automatically builds what you need: a complete AI interview ready to run, or a fully configured hiring workflow with matching criteria, screening logic, and interviews connected end-to-end.
You stay in control of the details. Mark skills as mandatory or optional, set question counts, pick a humanoid or branded avatar, and configure the introduction. Then go live.
An interview that feels like a conversation
Most AI interviews feel scripted. Our AI avatar conducts conversations the way experienced interviewers do, listening carefully, paraphrasing responses, and asking deeper follow-up questions when an answer shows potential.
The experience is built around the candidate. Live captions support non-native speakers. Silence detection nudges thoughtful candidates without rushing them. And candidates can ask their own questions about the company and the role during the interview itself.
Every invitation can be branded. Every interview can be personalized to the candidate's resume. Candidates walk away feeling heard and fairly assessed, and that experience carries forward through word of mouth.
Fraud detection at every layer
Anyone can run an AI interview. Our AI Recruiter makes it possible to prove the candidate behind it was real, genuine, and independently assessed.
The proctoring agent monitors every interview across 30+ fraud signals, fused into a single AI-powered integrity score you can defend in any audit. Suspicious moments are flagged directly inside the session recording.
Unauthorized AI assistance is caught through content, style, speech patterns, and typing analysis, including reading from on-screen tools and browser plugins. Question pools are randomized, recently asked questions are auto-excluded, and overused ones are retired.
Deepfakes, virtual cameras, recorded feeds, and stand-ins are detected in real time, even under the low-light and blurred-background conditions meant to evade detection. Identity is verified against government ID with a face and name match, then rechecked during the interview to catch mid-session switches.
Bias-free evaluation you can defend
Evaluation is where most AI interview tools break down. The scoring is often surface-level, the reasoning unclear, and the decisions difficult to defend. Our AI Recruiter evaluates candidates with the depth, structure, and rigor of an experienced interviewer, assessing every dimension that matters.
Most AI hiring tools rely solely on an LLM. We build on top of it with twenty-five years of hiring data, evaluation context, and recruiter intelligence that generic models simply do not have access to.
Candidates are scored on skill correctness and depth, communication on the CEFR scale, behavioural signals, and, for coding, code correctness and efficiency. Every score is broken down question by question, with explainable reasoning behind each rating.
Evaluations are bias-free across gender, race, age, accent, and other personal attributes. Every recommendation is auditable, with the transcript and recording one click away. Recruiters and hiring managers act on evidence, not impressions.
Instant reports. Full audit trail.
The moment a candidate completes the interview, the evaluation report is ready. There is no waiting for interview panels to align, for consolidating notes, or for manually reviewing responses. Recruiters and hiring managers instantly receive a structured summary with skill-level assessments, communication scores, behavioural insights, and detailed evaluation breakdowns.
Every report is backed by complete evidence. The full interview transcript, audio and video recording, and detailed proctoring report sit alongside the scores, so any recommendation can be traced back to what actually happened in the interview.
Sharing is built in. Send secure web links to hiring managers, export individual reports as PDFs or detailed XLS files, or bulk-download reports across entire requisitions for compliance, audits, and downstream analytics.
Beyond interviews: the entire funnel on AI
The AI Interview agent is at the core of HirePro AI Recruiter, but the platform extends far beyond interviews. Multiple AI agents work together across the hiring funnel from the moment a job is created.
Create a job using a JD or a simple prompt. Resumes are automatically matched to the role, shortlisted candidates move through AI-led screening, and qualified applicants flow directly into interviews generated specifically for the role. The entire workflow runs end-to-end with minimal manual effort.
Recruiters remain in control throughout the process. They can approve, override, or step in at any stage, while AI agents handle the operational work between decisions so teams can focus on judgment, not administration.
Built for enterprise hiring workflows
Our AI Recruiter slots into the systems you already run. ATS integrations, a full REST API for custom workflows, and standard SSO let you wire it into your stack without rebuilding anything around it.
Day-to-day hiring operations run at scale with minimal manual effort. Candidates can be added in bulk through APIs, resume parsing, or XLS uploads, while branded invitations, reminders, expiry rules, reschedules, and no-show handling are managed automatically.
Access is controlled the way enterprise teams expect. Role-based permissions, SSO authentication, and bulk administrative actions give recruiters, hiring managers, and admins exactly the view and the powers they need; no more, no less.
Enterprise Security
Trust by design. Ethical. Secure. Compliant.
Ethical AI, security, privacy, and compliance are not afterthoughts. They are foundational principles woven into every layer of HirePro AI Recruiter. Built from the ground up on enterprise-grade infrastructure, the platform is engineered to meet the rigorous standards of ISO 27001, GDPR, and DPDPA.
Ethical AI starts with humans in control. Every model is rigorously tested across ten facets of recruitment ethics, spanning bias detection on protected attributes, PII handling, and decision explainability. Every recommendation is transparent and open to challenge, ensuring that AI augments hiring decisions without ever quietly making them. Recruiters decide; AI assists.
Customer data is hosted on Amazon Web Services with strong access controls. Personally identifiable information is encrypted at rest and in transit. Data can be deleted or extracted as needed.
Complete audit trails are maintained for every interview, every recruiter action, and every system event. Your security, compliance, and audit teams get the evidence they need, when they need it.
